title: SPLA/106/2013 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Ajab Singh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SPLA No. 106 of 2013
With
CRMA No. 1247 of 2013
In
GA No. 54 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. A.S. Gill, Deputy Advocate
General for the appellant / State.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the
accused / respondents.
Learned counsel for the accused /
respondents has no objection if 40 days delay
in filing the appeal is condoned.
We have perused the accompanying
affidavit and we find that reasons given for
delay in filing the appeal are sufficient to
condone the delay. Therefore, 40 days delay
in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
Application seeking condonation of
delay (CRMA No. 1247 of 2013) is allowed.
SPLA No. 106 of 2013
 Present appeal is preferred against the
judgment and order dated 15.04.2013, passed
by the IInd Additional Sessions Judge,
Haridwar in S.T. No. 237 of 2004.
 We have heard learned counsel for the
parties and have carefully perused the
impugned judgment and record. We are of
the opinion that judgment requires
consideration. Therefore, leave to appeal is
granted.
 Application seeking leave to appeal is
allowed.

GA No. 54 of 2013
 Admit the appeal.
 L.C.R. be summoned.
 List this appeal after paper book is
prepared and copies thereof are supplied to
the learned counsel for the parties in
accordance with Rules.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Alok Singh, J.)
 06.05.2015
Shiv
